note: First drafts only: one coder call per request through /api/chat with the app's OakScript Coder system prompt. No brief, no repair, no gates.

drafts.request: 20-bar Donchian channel breakout with buy and sell signals
drafts.code:
len = input(20, "Donchian Length", 2, 100, 1)
markerSize = input(1.0, "Marker Size", 0.2, 3.0, 0.1)

upper = highest(high, len)
lower = lowest(low, len)
mid = (upper + lower) / 2
upperPrev = upper[1]
lowerPrev = lower[1]

buySig = close > upperPrev
sellSig = close < lowerPrev

if buySig {
    plotshape(bar_index, low, "Buy", "triangleup", "#22cc88")
}

if sellSig {
    plotshape(bar_index, high, "Sell", "triangledown", "#ff4477")
}

if buySig {
    plotshape_3d(bar_index, low, "Buy", "coneup", "#22cc88", 1.0 * markerSize, 0, "3d")
}

if sellSig {
    plotshape_3d(bar_index, high, "Sell", "conedown", "#ff4477", 1.0 * markerSize, 0, "3d")
}

plot(upper, "Upper", "#22cc88", 1, "stepline")
plot(mid, "Mid", "#888888", 1, "stepline")
plot(lower, "Lower", "#ff4477", 1, "stepline")
plot3d(upper, "Upper 3D", "line3d", "#22cc88", "3d", 0)
plot3d(mid, "Mid 3D", "line3d", "#888888", "3d", 1)
plot3d(lower, "Lower 3D", "line3d", "#ff4477", "3d", 2)

drafts.request: Breakout of the previous 10-bar range with volume confirmation
drafts.code:
rangeLen = input(10, "Range Length", 5, 50, 1)
volLen = input(20, "Volume Avg Length", 5, 100, 1)
volMult = input(1.5, "Volume Multiplier", 0.5, 5.0, 0.1)
markerSize = input(1.0, "Marker Size", 0.2, 3.0, 0.1)

prevHighRaw = highest(high, rangeLen)
prevLowRaw = lowest(low, rangeLen)
prevHigh = prevHighRaw[1]
prevLow = prevLowRaw[1]
volAvg = sma(volume, volLen)
volOk = volume > volAvg * volMult
breakUp = close > prevHigh
breakDn = close < prevLow

sellSig = breakDn and volOk

if sellSig {
  plotshape(bar_index, high, "Sell", "triangledown", "#ff4477")

}
if sellSig {

}

plot(prevLow, "Prev Low", "#ff4477", 1, "stepline")
plot3d(prevHigh, "Prev High 3D", "line3d", "#22cc88", "3d", 0)

drafts.request: Stochastic %K and %D with crossovers in the overbought and oversold zones
drafts.code:
input(14, "%K Length", 1, 100, 1)
input(3, "%D Smoothing", 1, 50, 1)
input(80, "Overbought Level", 50, 95, 1)
input(20, "Oversold Level", 5, 50, 1)
input(1.0, "Marker Size", 0.2, 3.0, 0.1)

ll = lowest(low, 14)
hh = highest(high, 14)
rng = hh - ll
kRaw = 100 * (close - ll) / (rng + 1e-9)
k = rng == 0 ? 50 : kRaw
d = sma(k, 3)

buySig = crossover(k, d) and k < 20
sellSig = crossunder(k, d) and k > 80

if buySig {
    plotshape(bar_index, low, "Buy", "triangleup", "#22cc88")
    plotshape_3d(bar_index, k, "Buy", "coneup", "#22cc88", 1.0, 0, "separate")
}

if sellSig {
    plotshape(bar_index, high, "Sell", "triangledown", "#ff4477")
    plotshape_3d(bar_index, k, "Sell", "conedown", "#ff4477", 1.0, 0, "separate")
}

plot(k, "%K", "#2962ff", 2, "line", "separate")
plot(d, "%D", "#ff6d00", 2, "line", "separate")
hline(80, "#ff4477", "separate")
hline(20, "#22cc88", "separate")
plot3d(k, "%K Ribbon", "ribbon", "#2962ff", "separate", 0)
plot3d(d, "%D Line", "line3d", "#ff6d00", "separate", 1)

drafts.request: Bollinger Band squeeze breakout signals
drafts.code:
input(20, "BB Length", 2, 100, 1)
input(2.0, "BB Mult", 0.5, 4.0, 0.1)
input(120, "Squeeze Lookback", 20, 250, 1)
input(10, "Breakout Window", 2, 30, 1)
input(1.0, "Marker Size", 0.2, 3.0, 0.1)

basis = sma(close, 20)
sd = stdev(close, 20)
upper = basis + 2.0 * sd
lower = basis - 2.0 * sd
bandwidth = (upper - lower) / (basis + 1e-9)
sqLowLong = lowest(bandwidth, 120)
lowShort = lowest(bandwidth, 10)
wasSqueeze = lowShort == sqLowLong
inSqueeze = bandwidth == sqLowLong

var lastLabel = -1000

buySig = crossover(close, upper) and wasSqueeze
sellSig = crossunder(close, lower) and wasSqueeze

if buySig {
    plotshape(bar_index, low, "Buy", "triangleup", "#22cc88")
}
if sellSig {
    plotshape(bar_index, high, "Sell", "triangledown", "#ff4477")
}
if buySig {
    plotshape_3d(bar_index, low, "Buy", "coneup", "#22cc88", 1.0, 0, "3d")
}
if sellSig {
    plotshape_3d(bar_index, high, "Sell", "conedown", "#ff4477", 1.0, 1, "3d")
}
if buySig and bar_index - lastLabel > 20 {
    label3d(bar_index, high, "Squeeze Break", "#22cc88", 1.0, 0, "3d")
    lastLabel := bar_index
}
if sellSig and bar_index - lastLabel > 20 {
    label3d(bar_index, low, "Squeeze Break", "#ff4477", 1.0, 1, "3d")
    lastLabel := bar_index
}

plot(basis, "Basis", "#ffcc33", 1, "line")
plot(upper, "Upper", "#22cc88", 1, "line")
plot(lower, "Lower", "#ff4477", 1, "line")
plot3d(upper, "BB Upper 3D", "ribbon", "#22cc88", "3d", 0)
plot3d(lower, "BB Lower 3D", "ribbon", "#ff4477", "3d", 1)

drafts.request: Keltner channel breakout using ATR
drafts.code:
maLen = input(20, "Basis Length", 1, 200, 1)
atrLen = input(10, "ATR Length", 1, 100, 1)
mult = input(1.5, "ATR Multiplier", 0.1, 5.0, 0.1)
markerSize = input(1.0, "Marker Size", 0.2, 3.0, 0.1)

basis = ema(close, maLen)
atrVal = atr(atrLen)
upper = basis + mult * atrVal
lower = basis - mult * atrVal
upperPrev = upper[1]
lowerPrev = lower[1]
closePrev = close[1]
warmed = bar_index > maLen and bar_index > atrLen

buySig = warmed and close > upperPrev and closePrev <= upperPrev
sellSig = warmed and close < lowerPrev and closePrev >= lowerPrev

if buySig {
  plotshape(bar_index, low, "Buy", "triangleup", "#22cc88")
  plotshape_3d(bar_index, low, "Buy", "coneup", "#22cc88", 1.0 * markerSize, 0, "3d")
}
if sellSig {
  plotshape(bar_index, high, "Sell", "triangledown", "#ff4477")
  plotshape_3d(bar_index, high, "Sell", "conedown", "#ff4477", 1.0 * markerSize, 1, "3d")
}

plot(basis, "Basis", "#ffcc33", 1, "line")
plot(upper, "Upper", "#ff4477", 1, "line")
plot(lower, "Lower", "#22cc88", 1, "line")
plot3d(upper, "Keltner Upper", "line3d", "#ff4477", "3d", 0)
plot3d(lower, "Keltner Lower", "line3d", "#22cc88", "3d", 1)
plot3d(basis, "Keltner Basis", "line3d", "#ffcc33", "3d", 2)

drafts.request: Williams %R with signals at -80 and -20
drafts.code:

drafts.request: Chandelier exit: trailing stop from the highest high minus 3 ATR, with exit signals
VWAP with standard deviation bands and signals on band touches
drafts.code:
input(true, "Reset Daily", 0, 1, 1)
input(1.0, "Band Mult 1", 0.1, 5.0, 0.1)
input(2.0, "Band Mult 2", 0.1, 5.0, 0.1)
input(1.0, "Marker Size", 0.2, 3.0, 0.1)

tp = (high + low + close) / 3
v = volume
dRef = security("1d", close)
newDay = bar_index == 0 or dRef != dRef[1]

var cumPV = 0.0
var cumV = 0.0
var cumP2V = 0.0

if newDay {
  cumPV := tp * v
  cumV := v
  cumP2V := tp * tp * v
} else {
  cumPV := cumPV[1] + tp * v
  cumV := cumV[1] + v
  cumP2V := cumP2V[1] + tp * tp * v
}

vwap = cumV > 0 ? cumPV / cumV : tp
meanSq = cumV > 0 ? cumP2V / cumV : tp * tp
vari = meanSq - vwap * vwap
variFix = vari > 0 ? vari : 0
sd = sqrt(variFix)

upper1 = vwap + input1 * sd
lower1 = vwap - input1 * sd
upper2 = vwap + input2 * sd
lower2 = vwap - input2 * sd

buySig = low <= lower2
sellSig = high >= upper2

if buySig {
  plotshape(bar_index, low, "Buy", "triangleup", "#22cc88")
  plotshape_3d(bar_index, low, "Buy", "coneup", "#22cc88", 1.0 * input3, 0, "3d")
}

if sellSig {
  plotshape(bar_index, high, "Sell", "triangledown", "#ff4477")
  plotshape_3d(bar_index, high, "Sell", "conedown", "#ff4477", 1.0 * input3, 0, "3d")
}

plot(vwap, "VWAP", "#22aaff", 2, "line")
plot(upper1, "Upper 1SD", "#ffaa00", 1, "stepline")
plot(lower1, "Lower 1SD", "#ffaa00", 1, "stepline")
plot(upper2, "Upper 2SD", "#ff4477", 1, "stepline")
plot(lower2, "Lower 2SD", "#22cc88", 1, "stepline")
fill(upper2, lower2, "#22aaff")

plot3d(vwap, "VWAP 3D", "ribbon", "#22aaff", "3d")
plot3d(upper2, "Upper 2SD 3D", "line3d", "#ff4477", "3d", 1)
plot3d(lower2, "Lower 2SD 3D", "line3d", "#22cc88", "3d", 2)

drafts.request: Inside bar breakout signals
drafts.code:
markerSize = input(1.0, "Marker Size", 0.2, 3.0, 0.1)
showBg = input(1, "Highlight Inside Bars", 0, 1, 1)

inside = high < high[1] and low > low[1]
rangeSize = high - low
motherRange = high[1] - low[1]
contraction = rangeSize < motherRange

var ibHigh = 0.0
var ibLow = 0.0
var momHigh = 0.0
var momLow = 0.0

if inside {
    ibHigh := high
    ibLow := low
    momHigh := high[1]
    momLow := low[1]
}

wasInside = inside[1]
prevIbHigh = high[1]
prevIbLow = low[1]

buySig = wasInside and close > prevIbHigh
sellSig = wasInside and close < prevIbLow

if buySig {
    plotshape(bar_index, low, "Buy", "triangleup", "#22cc88")
}
if sellSig {
    plotshape(bar_index, high, "Sell", "triangledown", "#ff4477")
}

if buySig {
    plotshape_3d(bar_index, low, "Buy", "coneup", "#22cc88", markerSize, 0, "3d")
}
if sellSig {
    plotshape_3d(bar_index, high, "Sell", "conedown", "#ff4477", markerSize, 0, "3d")

drafts.request: Alert when ATR rises 50% above its 20-bar average
drafts.code:
atrLen = input(14, "ATR Length", 1, 100, 1)
avgLen = input(20, "Average Length", 2, 100, 1)
threshMult = input(1.5, "Threshold Mult", 1.0, 3.0, 0.1)
markerSize = input(1.0, "Marker Size", 0.2, 3.0, 0.1)

// ATR: Wilder RMA — validated vs TradingView (not EMA, 30% too reactive)
atrVal = atr(atrLen)
// 20-bar average: sliding-window SMA O(n)
atrAvg = sma(atrVal, avgLen)
trigLevel = atrAvg * threshMult
ratio = atrVal / (atrAvg + 1e-9)

var lastLabelBar = -1000.0

warmup = bar_index > atrLen + avgLen
spikeHold = warmup and atrVal > trigLevel
spikeCross = warmup and crossover(atrVal, trigLevel)
canLabel = bar_index - lastLabelBar > 20
labelSig = spikeCross and canLabel

if spikeCross {
  plotshape(bar_index, high, "ATR Spike", "triangledown", "#ff4477")
}

if spikeCross {
  plotshape_3d(bar_index, high, "ATR Spike", "conedown", "#ff4477", markerSize, 0, "separate")
}

if labelSig {
  label3d(bar_index, high, "ATR +50%", "#ff4477", 1.0, 0, "separate")
  lastLabelBar := bar_index
}

bgcolor(spikeHold, "#ff447722")

plot(atrVal, "ATR", "#22cc88", 1, "line")
plot(trigLevel, "Trigger 1.5x Avg", "#ff4477", 1, "line")
plot3d(atrVal, "ATR Terrain", "ribbon", "#22cc88", "separate")
plot3d(trigLevel, "Trigger Ridge", "line3d", "#ff4477", "separate", 1)

drafts.request: Rolling z-score of close over 30 bars with signals at plus and minus 2
drafts.code:
len = input(30, "Z Length", 2, 200, 1)
upperThresh = input(2.0, "Upper Signal", 0.5, 5.0, 0.1)
lowerThresh = input(-2.0, "Lower Signal", -5.0, -0.5, 0.1)
smoothLen = input(5, "Smooth Length", 1, 30, 1)
markerSize = input(1.0, "Marker Size", 0.2, 3.0, 0.1)

mean = sma(close, len)
sd = stdev(close, len)
safeSd = sd < 1e-9
zScore = safeSd ? 0.0 : (close - mean) / sd
zSmooth = ema(zScore, smoothLen)

buySig = zScore[1] >= lowerThresh and zScore < lowerThresh
sellSig = zScore[1] <= upperThresh and zScore > upperThresh

if buySig {
    plotshape(bar_index, low, "Buy", "triangleup", "#22cc88")
    plotshape_3d(bar_index, zScore, "Buy", "coneup", "#22cc88", markerSize, 0, "separate")
}
if sellSig {

    plotshape_3d(bar_index, zScore, "Sell", "conedown", "#ff4477", markerSize, 1, "separate")
}

plot(zScore, "Z-Score", "#33aaff", 1, "line", "separate")
plot(zSmooth, "Z-Smooth", "#ffaa22", 1, "line", "separate")
hline(upperThresh, "#ff4477", "separate")
hline(lowerThresh, "#22cc88", "separate")
hline(0.0, "#888888", "separate")
plot3d(zScore, "Z-Score 3D", "ribbon", "#33aaff", "separate")
plot3d(zSmooth, "Z-Smooth 3D", "line3d", "#ffaa22", "separate", 1)

drafts.request: Stochastic RSI smoothed with signals in the extreme zones
drafts.code:
input(14, "RSI Length", 2, 100, 1)
input(14, "Stoch Length", 2, 100, 1)
input(3, "K Smoothing", 1, 20, 1)
input(3, "D Smoothing", 1, 20, 1)

input(20, "Oversold", 0, 50, 1)
input(5, "Signal Cooldown", 1, 50, 1)
input(1.0, "Marker Size", 0.2, 3.0, 0.1)

r = rsi(close, 14)
ll = lowest(r, 14)
hh = highest(r, 14)
rng = hh - ll
rawK = (r - ll) / (rng + 0.000000001) * 100
k = sma(rawK, 3)
d = sma(k, 3)

var lastSig = -1000
coolOk = bar_index - lastSig[1] > 5
rawBuy = crossover(k, d) and k < 20
rawSell = crossunder(k, d) and k > 80
buySig = rawBuy and coolOk
sellSig = rawSell and coolOk

if buySig {
    lastSig := bar_index
}
if sellSig {
    lastSig := bar_index
}

if buySig {
    plotshape(bar_index, low, "Buy", "triangleup", "#22cc88")
}
if sellSig {
    plotshape(bar_index, high, "Sell", "triangledown", "#ff4477")
}
if buySig {

}
if sellSig {
    plotshape_3d(bar_index, high, "Sell", "conedown", "#ff4477", 1.0, 0, "separate")
}

plot(k, "StochRSI K", "#22aaff", 2, "line")
plot(d, "StochRSI D", "#ffaa22", 2, "line")
hline(80, "#ff4477")
hline(20, "#22cc88")
fill(k, d, "#22aaff")
